content.title: About Fetch.ai
content.description: Fetch.ai is delivering AI to the crypto economy. Digital Twins, powered by artificial intelligence, can provide automation to decentralized finance that can serve the needs of a single user or aggregate millions of data points for on-chain oracles. These agent-based systems provide greater flexibility, speed and crypto-economic security than existing oracle networks and represent the future of decentralized finance. This technology enables creation of personalized oracles that maintain user’s DeFi positions using decentralized and non-custodial protocols to increase the security and convenience of crypto asset management.

content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: What is Ronin?
content.description: Ronin is an EVM blockchain specifically forged for gaming. Launched by Sky Mavis, the creator of Web3’s breakout title Axie Infinity which has generated over $1.3B in revenue, Ronin is the only blockchain proven to scale a single game to accommodate millions of daily active users and has processed over $4B in NFT volumes. Ronin optimizes for near-instant transactions and negligible fees that enable millions of in-game transactions to occur seamlessly, making it the leading choice for Web3 games.

content.title: About Solana (SOL)
content.description: Solana is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain built for mass adoption, offering a fast and low-cost environment for decentralized applications.

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: About Akedo (AKE)
content.description: Akedo is a multi-agent artificial intelligence framework designed to enable autonomous content creation and intelligent collaboration within the gaming industry.

content.title: What is Aeon?
content.description: AEON is building a native settlement infrastructure for the agentic economy, specifically designed to eliminate three major friction points traditional finance networks pose for agent collaboration: fee overhead, programmability gap, and settlement lag. Leveraging leading agentic protocols such as x402, ERC-8004, Google AP2, and MCP, AEON enables autonomous, verifiable AI agent transactions at scale and bridges Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interactions with real-world settlement and continuous value flows. Serving more than 2 million users and processing 30M monthly transactions, AEON is backed by YZi Labs and IDG Capital, with participation from investors including HashKey Capital, Stanford Blockchain Builders Fund, etc.

content.title: What is Hyperliquid about?
content.description: Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship DEX trading platform, the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, real world assets (RWAs), and a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in decentralized finance (defi).

content.title: What Is ether.fi?
content.description:
ether.fi is a modern crypto neobank that replaces the traditional consumer bank. Users can save, grow, and spend their crypto through one connected experience. Common use cases include buying tokens, earning on crypto through vaults, sending money globally through fiat on and off ramps, and purchasing every day goods through a credit card.

Behind that experience is crypto-native, non-custodial infrastructure that keeps users in control of their assets. Rather than separating investments from everyday finances, ether.fi makes it possible to put assets to work, access liquidity against them, and use them in daily life from the same platform.

Stake provides access to Ethereum staking while keeping positions liquid and usable. Liquid automates onchain strategies designed to generate variable yield across eligible assets. Cash supports card spending and payments. Trading, transfers, and collateralized borrowing bring additional flexibility, giving users more ways to manage and use their wealth without first selling their holdings.

With more than $3 billion in assets across the platform, ether.fi combines the technical foundation of a leading DeFi protocol with the simplicity and utility of a modern fintech platform. The result is a financial home for modern wealth: one place to grow it, move it, borrow against it, and use it—while remaining in control.
